idea-plugin.name: AnyReader
idea-plugin.description:
AnyReader is a clean, lightweight, and privacy-conscious document reader for JetBrains IDEs. Read local EPUB, PDF, Markdown, TXT, and image collections right inside the IDE sidebar without cluttering your editor tabs or recent files history.

Core Features

  • Multi-Format Support: Native rendering for EPUB 2/3 (via embedded JCEF with zero temp files and offline-only resource isolation), PDF (powered by Apache PDFBox with HiDPI scaling, rotation, drag-pan, and zoom), Markdown, plain TXT (auto charset detection for UTF-8/GB18030), and local image folders.
  • Full-Text & Inline Search: Instant in-chapter/in-page find (Ctrl+F) and asynchronous book-wide keyword search with contextual snippets and direct jump-to-match.
  • Theme & Typography Customization: 5 built-in themes including Follow IDE (automatically matches your current IDE color scheme), custom colors, font family, size, line spacing, padding, PDF color filters (Dark Invert, Warm Sepia, Grayscale), and canvas opacity control.
  • Bookmarks & Bookshelf Management: Pin favorite documents, filter by group or alias, relink moved files without losing progress or notes, export bookmarks to Markdown, and automatically resume from the exact last chapter/page and scroll offset.
  • Low-Profile & Privacy-Focused Design: Compact Docs tool window, optional grayscale/collapsed image placeholders with lightbox zoom, custom document display aliases, quick reference view toggle (Alt+Q or double Esc), and optional single-line status bar reader.

AnyReader 是一款轻量、低存在感且注重隐私的 JetBrains IDE 本地文档阅读插件，支持直接在右侧边栏查阅 EPUB、PDF、Markdown、TXT 与本地图片集，不污染编辑器标签页和最近文件历史。

主要功能

  • 多格式阅读：支持 EPUB 2/3（基于内存虚拟协议隔离加载图片与样式，零端口零落盘且阻断外网请求）、PDF（PDFBox 高分屏渲染、旋转、拖拽平移、自适应宽度与缩放）、Markdown、TXT（UTF-8/GB18030 自动嗅探与章节目录识别）及本地图片册浏览。
  • 双层关键词检索：支持页内即时查找（Ctrl+F）与全书跨章/跨页异步全文检索，展示上下文摘要并点击精准定位高亮。
  • 配色与排版调节：内置「跟随 IDE」等 5 套主题、自定义前背景色/字体/字号/行高/边距，PDF 专属支持暗色反色/护眼暖色/灰阶滤镜及透明度调节。
  • 书架与书签管理：支持分组筛选、文档别名、缺失文件重定位保留历史进度与书签、书签摘录/备注与导出 Markdown、末次章节页码及滚动偏移自动记忆。
  • 隐私保护与低调交互：工具窗低调命名为 Docs，支持图片灰阶降噪/胶囊折叠与灯箱放大，支持快捷切换开发速查视图（Alt+Q 或双击 Esc）及可选状态栏单行微读。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release of AnyReader.
  • Added EPUB 2/3, PDF, Markdown, TXT, and image directory viewers with persistent reading position tracking.
  • Added full-text cross-chapter/page search, inline find bar, bookmarks with Markdown export, bookshelf management, customizable themes/typography, image privacy modes, and quick reference toggle (Alt+Q).

1.0.0 初始版本

  • 首发上线 AnyReader：支持 EPUB 2/3、PDF、Markdown、TXT 及图片目录阅读与精确末次位置记忆。
  • 支持全书与页内关键词检索、书签备注与导出、书架与别名管理、5 套配色与排版实时调节、图片隐私折叠灯箱及快捷切换速查视图（Alt+Q）。
